name: XPRIZE Quantum Applications
organizer: XPRIZE Foundation, Google Quantum AI, and GESDA
description: XPRIZE Quantum Applications is a three-year, USD 5 million global competition challenging teams to develop deployable quantum algorithms for real-world impact in health, climate, energy, and materials science. Launched in March 2024, it attracted 376 registered teams from 82 countries, with seven Phase I finalists sharing USD 1 million in December 2025. A Phase II Wildcard Registration window opened in early 2026, with the grand prize of USD 3 million to be awarded in March 2027.
prizes: USD 5 million total (grand prize USD 3 million)
eligibility: Open to global teams from 82+ countries

news.title: Pasqal selected as Phase II wildcard finalist in XPRIZE Quantum Applications competition
news.excerpt: Pasqal was chosen as one of five wildcard finalists out of 62 Wildcard Registration submissions, advancing to the Phase II stage of the XPRIZE Quantum Applications competition alongside the original seven Phase I finalists. The grand prize of USD 3 million will be awarded in March 2027.
